For the blue line (CoT), after peaking around Sampling Time 15, the line is not stable; it fluctuates and trends downwards to a final value of ~77.5.
The orange line (AnP) reaches its peak of approximately 73 around Sampling Time 10, not 5. At time 5, its value is about 72.5.
The final value for the orange line (AnP) at Sampling Time 25 is approximately 72.5, not 72.
The light blue line (L2M) starts at an accuracy value of approximately 72, not 71.
